scripts.test:integration: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$PWD") php vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit-integration.xml.dist
scripts.test:integration:legacy: wp-env run tests-cli wp wc hpos disable && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration:hpos: wp-env run tests-cli wp wc hpos enable && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration:all: npm run test:integration:legacy && npm run test:integration:hpos
